What to expect

Unhurried consultations, kept on one record.

Every visit is with the same family medicine specialist, so your history, medications and screening dates are already in front of the doctor when you sit down. Follow-ups, referrals and chronic reviews are planned rather than repeated from scratch.

Your doctor

Care for whole families,
not single visits.

A family medicine specialist is a doctor with advanced training in caring for whole families over years, not single visits — from a child's first vaccinations to a parent's chronic reviews and a grandparent's functional screening.

  • Family Physician, College of Family Physicians Singapore
  • Physician Faculty, National University Health System
  • Consultations in English and Mandarin
  • Care for every age, on one record

Healthier SG

One doctor,
one health plan.

Healthier SG is Singapore's national programme pairing every resident with a family doctor for long-term preventive care. Enrolling with us keeps your screenings, vaccinations and chronic reviews with the same specialist.

How enrolment works
01
Enrol
Choose Cashew Family Medicine Clinic as your Healthier SG clinic through the HealthHub app or at the front desk.
02
First consultation
We review your history and agree a health plan covering screening, vaccinations and any long-term conditions.
03
Follow through
Reviews stay with the same doctor, with subsidised screenings and vaccinations under the programme.
